2609.35639.title: GPUPhysBench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Correct and Efficient GPU Physics Simulation
2609.35639.paper_summary: Writing fast GPU code for physical simulation is difficult: implementations must preserve numerical accuracy while handling irregular data access, synchronization, and iterative solvers. We introduce GPUPhysBench, a benchmark of 50 tasks testing whether coding agents can meet these demands. Tasks cover fluids, deformable solids, and granular materials, from individual simulation operators to complete simulators. Agents write, compile, test, and optimize GPU code with access to a NVIDIA GPU under fixed time budgets. We report pass rates and runtime performance relative to expert-optimized reference implementations. In a single-attempt evaluation of six frontier model-harness pairs, the two strongest pass all 50 tasks, but even the fastest reaches at least 0.9 the reference speed on only 22% of them, and no submission is more than 5% faster than the reference. The largest gaps arise in collision detection, constraint solving, and iterative solvers. GPUPhysBench brings physical simulation workloads to coding-agent evaluation, testing both the ability to implement numerical methods correctly and the ability to make them run efficiently.
2609.35639.paper_summary_zh: 撰寫快速的 GPU 代碼以進行物理模擬是困難的：實現必須在處理不規則數據訪問、同步和迭代求解器的同時保持數值準確性。我們介紹了 GPUPhysBench，這是一個包含 50 個任務的基準測試，旨在測試編碼代理是否能滿足這些需求。任務涵蓋流體、可變形固體和顆粒材料，從單個模擬運算符到完整的模擬器。代理在固定的時間預算內編寫、編譯、測試和優化 GPU 代碼，並可以訪問 NVIDIA GPU。我們報告通過率和相對於專家優化參考實現的運行時性能。在對六個前沿模型-工具組合的單次評估中，兩個最強的代理通過了所有 50 個任務，但即使是最快的代理在僅 22% 的任務中也僅達到參考速度的 0.9，且沒有任何提交比參考快超過 5%。在碰撞檢測、約束求解和迭代求解器中出現了最大的差距。GPUPhysBench 將物理模擬工作負載引入編碼代理評估，測試正確實現數值方法的能力以及使其高效運行的能力。
